verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only user-built reusable templates ('Save hours of manual setup with reusable templates', sharing templates with your team, standardizing your most-used agreements) and CLM dynamic templates. None of it shows Docusign providing a library of vetted, ready-made legal documents such as NDAs, agreements or policies that would replace counsel. The template features assume you already have the legal content, so the story's core capability is unevidenced.
